# Antalya Bridge

> Personal, multilingual consulting for international guests: Antalya travel
> consulting, online Turkish lessons, and guidance for studying in Turkey.
> Based in Antalya, Türkiye. Service in Turkish, English, Russian, Kazakh and Uzbek.

## Services

- Antalya Travel Consulting: Hotel selection, airport transfers, car rental
  coordination, and liaison with trusted local providers. We do not sell fixed
  packages; trips are planned around each guest.
- Online Turkish Lessons: Private lessons by appointment with a native teacher.
  15 / 30 / 60 minute sessions, on Zoom or in person in Antalya.
- Study in Turkey Guidance: Help with university/program selection, applications,
  scholarships (including Türkiye Bursları), document preparation, and arrival.

## Who we are

A small Antalya-based team. One works in hotel sales (tourism industry insider);
the other came to Turkey as a scholarship student and now teaches Turkish.

## Contact & payment

- Contact via WhatsApp, Telegram, or the website contact form. A real person
  handles every booking and payment; the bot only provides information.
- Payment: guests in Kazakhstan pay via Kaspi; guests elsewhere pay via
  cryptocurrency (USDT, BTC and others). Every payment is confirmed personally.

## Audience

International guests, especially from Kazakhstan, Russia, and Uzbekistan.
Turkey-based customers are not the target audience.
